title: fix: preserve original prompts after Gateway restarts
body: Fixes #187143 ## What Problem This Solves An ordinary Control UI request can disappear from chat history when a graceful Gateway restart interrupts it before the first response. The resumed task can finish successfully while the conversation shows only the restart instruction and the resulting work. The original bytes remain stored, but orphan recovery has moved the original message off the active history branch. ## User Impact The accepted human prompt remains visible as its original message, separately from the new system resume instruction. Recovery keeps the same session and creator, and continues to use current authority. This requires no configuration change or migration and does not replay the original execution or promise exactly-once behavior for arbitrary interrupted external actions. ## Why This Change Was Made Fresh restart inputs carry `internal_system` provenance with source `restart`. The session-boundary orphan repair did not recognize that continuation when deciding whether to preserve an unanswered human message. It reset the active branch and folded the old text into the new input's private model projection instead. This change handles that existing restart input in the existing preservation guard. It leaves shared provenance policies used by fallback, accounting, and other runtimes unchanged. The regression reopens persisted history and checks that the original row and a distinct resume row remain. The real-Gateway case also checks original message identity and provenance, creator identity, one disabled automation, and visibility after reloading the page. ## Evidence - On base `0b538f7d5a4d9e3328f572cc07fe23402f733f36`, the real Control UI/native Gateway replacement case reproduced original history and rendered-message counts changing from one to zero. Selected identity/hash observations showed the stored original was unchanged while a new leaf-control record detached it; the returned page contained only four messages, so the history limit was not responsible. - The focused persisted-boundary regression failed on the unfixed owner and passed with the correction. All 11 selected owner/caller/control files passed, totaling 148 tests, including prompt-prefix stability and restart authority controls. - Changed-file formatting/lint and the selected compiler checks passed. The existing real-Gateway restart case passed on the committed tree: original message once with the same ID, separate resume instruction once, unchanged session/creator, one disabled job, and original text visible after reload. The scenario took 25.1 seconds of test time (84.3 seconds including Vitest setup/transform). The deterministic case uses a controlled Responses provider and its existing routing marker. A separate normal guest request for an onboarding plan was exercised on the production-identical `74cebbb` runtime. Native OCM stop/start replaced the Gateway after admission, with `hasActiveRun: true` and before the first assistant reply. Recovery kept the original message ID/hash, session, creator, owner, visibility, guest scopes, and model selection; one resume input led to a useful completed plan. The pre-stop projected status was `queued`, so this observation does not claim the original live provider request had already started. The live command's final exact-text DOM lookup timed out because the long answer left the original outside the rendered window. A read-only scroll of the same recovered conversation revealed it once, without another user prompt or restart. The original failed observer record is retained alongside that completed readback. Independent engineering review and the canonical automated review are clean on `60a33153dd9b76b179bce216a19ef8c376daf58b`. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40806384923) passed on that head, including lint, compiler, and test-size checks. The dedicated real-Gateway CI family was scope-skipped on this head; the named restart case was executed through the separate native proof above. The unrelated channel-management case was not rerun in that focused invocation. [ClawSweeper’s exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187157#issuecomment-6485749858) reports Diamond with no findings. The final target was also reproduced as broken at `8d46327b2656a3bb09889167570c4a35eb061e42`; the same scenario passed with this patch combined with that target (21.7 seconds of test time). ## Visual evidence []() | Before | After | | --- | --- | | ![Before the fix: only the restart instruction and completed response remain in active history\.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bc42b8-054e-48c0-bfd8-162c8795f4b6) | ![After the fix: the original user prompt remains above the separate restart instruction and completed disabled automation\.](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fff63701-baca-4f3d-8e08-548e90f13913) | ### Exact\-head controlled\-provider restart and recovery https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4b90485a-93ca-4234-9e15-33c0b6f71d39 ### Visual verification - Baseline: 0b538f7d5a4d9e3328f572cc07fe23402f733f36 - Exact head: `60a33153dd9b76b179bce216a19ef8c376daf58b` - Scenario: Submit a disabled\-reminder request through Control UI, replace the Gateway at the controlled provider checkpoint, and inspect the completed conversation\. - Runtime/build: Real Gateway and Chromium with a controlled Responses provider\. Tested tree a7805569223c1e766e55f709b24652e4b732a914, committed unchanged as 60a33153dd9b76b179bce216a19ef8c376daf58b\. Browser viewport 1280×900; matched main\-conversation crops 970×780\. - Original prompt in active history: before: 0; after: 1, same message identity - Restart input: 1 separate system resume instruction - Requested automation: 1 job, still disabled - Same synthetic request, viewport, light theme, and identical crop\. Native generated job IDs/timestamps differ between independent fixtures\. - The candidate also reloads and scrolls to the original\. Baseline server history contains no original row, so the viewport cannot explain the before/after difference\. - Before observation\-only overlay changes only diagnostics in the test; production source matches the baseline commit\. - Final browser assertions passed on the exact committed tree\. - Captioned video preserves the full recorded interaction; its last frame is held for readability\. - Original screenshots and source recording retained during review\.
